title: Mutations and invalidation
expectedPositive: Create with a valid key; verify one 201, then a GET refreshes the matching list. A 422 must never produce an invalidation-based success state.
expectedNegative: The starter sends a POST without invalidating task-list queries and has no idempotency contract.
securityBoundary: A retry that regenerates the idempotency key may produce duplicate tasks. Avoid retrying unauthorized or validation failures automatically.
